consent.heading: Data Privacy Consent
consent.consentText: By using this portal, you consent to the collection and processing of your personal data for the purpose of administering social protection programs. Your data will be stored securely and used only for program-related activities. You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data at any time.
consent.declineInfo: If you decline, you will not be able to use this portal. You can withdraw consent at any time by contacting us.
consent.checkboxLabel: I have read and agree to the data privacy terms.
